name: Icon Button
description: A minimal icon-only button with a required accessible label.

items.description: When triggering an in-page action that has no room for a visible text label.
When the action is navigation to another page.

alternative.rationale: Links communicate navigation; buttons communicate actions.

agentDocumentBlocks.purpose: Trigger a user-initiated in-page action using an icon, with no visible text label.

items.description: Use icon-button for icon-only, in-page actions; use type-ref for navigation to a URL.

items.guidance: Do not use for navigating to a different page or URL.
Using an icon button to navigate to another page.
items.rationale: Instead: Use a link element with href.
